actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed 12.5 (>5) and was the highest contributor in the latest round; with a wallet of 4.4, the maximum affordable severity is floor(4.4/0.3)=14, so punish Resident2 and send the required discouraging broadcast.

message.reasoning: We need to decide action. Look at latest round 4 contributions: Resident2:12.5, Resident5:4.69. Threshold >5, highest is Resident2 with 12.5. We have wallet 4.4. Punishment severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost) = floor(4.4 / 0.3)= floor(14.666)=14. So can punish Resident2 severity 14 costing 14*0.3=4.2 <= wallet. Do that. Also broadcast message. Actions: punish target Resident2 amount 14, and broadcast. Explanation.
